newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - Dlr set for attack on 1.7750, 1.7686.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dlr set for attack on 1.7750, 1.7686.

text.p: The 1994 highs are the limit for dollar/mark, although probably not for very long, analysts said on Wednesday.
They noted dollar/mark set fresh 40-month highs for three consecutive sessions since Monday, breaking through a strong resistance at 1.7530 to peak at 1.7550 on Wednesday.

"We pierced the upper end of a channel from April, we are closing right on the top here. It's quite positive and we should see some good price action past 1.7550," said chartist Ben Morden at I.D.E.A. "We are looking at the 1994 high that was set on February 8, at 1.7686."
Also, mark/yen broke an important support at 65.55, suggesting further mark weakness all around.
"People are already projecting 3.00 on sterling/mark that would correspond to 1.77 on dollar/mark and cable at $1.70," Morden added.
Dollar/Swiss is packing momentum since taking out a rising trendline at 1.4660. The March 6 high of 1.4922 is the target.
As for dollar/yen, it is confined to a tight range, with 115.50 a tough resistance before the retest of 117.00, or a 38-percent retracement of the 1997 high-low move, from 127.47 to 110.62.
